required_identities: Event-bus infrastructure with RabbitMQ and Azure Service Bus as alternatives
required_relationships: Browser enters through Web BFF/API gateway over HTTP/REST.
Mobile enters through Mobile BFF/API gateway over HTTP/REST.
Both gateways call the Basket checkout endpoint.
Basket reads the customer basket from Redis.
Basket publishes UserCheckoutAcceptedIntegrationEvent before returning HTTP 202 Accepted.
The event bus delivers UserCheckoutAcceptedIntegrationEvent to Ordering, which dispatches an idempotent CreateOrderCommand using RequestId.
Ordering creates the order in Ordering SQL and publishes OrderStartedIntegrationEvent after the transaction.
Basket consumes OrderStartedIntegrationEvent and deletes the checked-out basket from Redis.
Catalog consumes OrderStatusChangedToAwaitingValidationIntegrationEvent, validates/decrements Catalog SQL stock, and publishes a stock-confirmed or stock-rejected result.
Ordering consumes the stock result; confirmed changes state and rejected cancels the order in Ordering SQL.
OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEvent reaches Payment and Ordering SignalR Hub.
Payment publishes OrderPaymentSuccededIntegrationEvent; Ordering consumes it and marks the order paid in Ordering SQL.
Ordering publishes a paid status and Ordering SignalR Hub consumes order-status events.
required_semantics: HTTP 202 acceptance does not wait for asynchronous order completion.
Publish, broker delivery, consumer handling, and persistence are distinct operations.
RabbitMQ and Azure Service Bus are alternatives, not two simultaneous required brokers.
A component identity is not duplicated merely to make layout easier.
unknown_or_unsupported: Payment-failure event contract, consumer, state transition, store write, and notification are not supplied.
The exact stock-result contract names are not supplied.
The exact paid-status contract name is not supplied.
The supplied excerpts establish consumption but not the producer transition for OrderStatusChangedToAwaitingValidationIntegrationEvent.
The final recipient or transport beyond Ordering SignalR Hub is not supplied.
forbidden_inventions: Named payment-failure event or terminal state
Simultaneously required RabbitMQ and Azure Service Bus brokers
